# Split into list
word_list = words.split()
print("Original words:", word_list)

# Reverse the order
reversed_list = word_list[::-1]
print("\nReversed words:", reversed_list)

# Join with single spaces
result = " ".join(reversed_list)
print("\nReversed order (space-separated):")
print(result)
